# Tantalizing Proof – David Rivera

> Tantalizing Proof (2009) is a piano-led album by David Rivera, American composer. Free printable piano scores with chords are on Lackadaisical Perfection.

## Album
- [Tantalizing Proof](https://tantalizingproof.com/): the album page, with tracks and listen links.

## Tracks
1. Transient Preservation
2. Rapturous Pursuit
3. Whimsical Introspection
4. Gregarious Sanctuary
5. Beloved Insistence
6. Precocious Spontaneity
7. Phantom Sensibility
8. Magnanimous Sigh
9. Lavish Persistence
10. Inevitable Despondency
11. Finessed Spectacle
12. Curious Aloofness
